description: Finds a site's XML sitemap (from robots.txt or the usual addresses), then validates it against the sitemaps.org protocol and Google's rules. Reads at most 5 MB; a sitemap index is validated as an index, its child sitemaps are listed but not fetched.

sitemap_url.description: A specific sitemap address to validate. Leave out to find it automatically.

url.description: A website address such as https://example.com or just example.com. Only public sites on the standard ports can be checked.

name: sitemap_check
title: Sitemap validator
